Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED: Elevated GPU utilization + queue depth increase in us-east + eu-west (Shadow Runner) | Severity: SEV-2

Sean Gallagher: on it. anyone else seeing customer-facing impact or is this shadow-only capacity?

Rafael Mendes: primary API p99 looks mostly flat (within budget), but GPU util on shadow pool jumped from ~45% -> 92% in 10m. queue depth climbing fast.

Keiko Yamamoto: autoscaler is pegged. we’re hitting max for the beta shadow worker ASG in us-east. backlog is spilling into eu-west.

Vanessa Ortiz: fleet view: H100 pool reservation for shadow is basically saturated. if this continues, it’ll start contending w/ dedicated capacity in us-east.

Sean Gallagher: ok mitigation first: disable shadow sampling globally. Rafael can you flip kill switch?

Rafael Mendes: yup. checking current config path. is it the new `shadow_traffic.global_enabled` flag or admin override?

Dylan Brooks: global kill switch is wired to Console admin + internal endpoint. use admin override if you don’t want to wait for config propagation.

Rafael Mendes: found it. running:
`rw-admin shadow-traffic set --global-enabled=false --reason "capacity spike"`

Incident Bot: Acknowledged by Rafael Mendes

Cole Summers: while that propagates, can we also lower per-route budgets? if someone set sampling 50% on a hot route, kill switch is safest but we should prevent re-enable.

Ethan Park: pulling recent RoutePolicy changes. seeing a config push ~25m ago that bumped sampling on `chat.completions` for 2 beta tenants.

Benji Okafor: :facepalm: looks like the policy validation allowed 0.5 where UI was supposed to cap at 0.05. might be a unit mismatch (percent vs fraction).

Sean Gallagher: ok so this is likely misconfig. Rafael after kill switch, also set those routes to 0 explicitly so we don’t bounce back when global re-enabled.

Rafael Mendes: kill switch response: 200 OK. propagation ETA ~60s. queue depth still increasing but slope slowing.

Keiko Yamamoto: seeing new workers stop taking jobs (good). queue depth is still high bc existing jobs running. do we want to drain or hard-cancel?

Mina Haddad: please avoid hard-cancel if it affects shared runtime resources. but shadow jobs are async; we can drop queued ones safely.

Cole Summers: we have `shadow_runner.drop_on_overflow` + admin endpoint for queue purge. i’d purge queued jobs now.

Rafael Mendes: ok doing purge for the shadow queue in us-east first.
`rw-admin shadow-traffic queue purge --region us-east --queue shadow-eval`

Incident Bot: Runbook link suggested: runbooks/runbook-shadow-runner-kill-switch

Rafael Mendes: purge initiated. also setting RoutePolicy shadow sampling to 0 for the 2 tenants.

Dylan Brooks: for visibility, which tenants? (so PM can notify)

Ethan Park: `cust_7H2...` and `cust_9QK...` (beta allowlist). both had `shadow.sample_rate: 0.5` on a shared prod route.

Sean Gallagher: ok keep ids in thread but don’t paste names/data. Dylan can you ping Marissa/Paula separately.

Logan Wright: telemetry side: `shadow_eval.run.count` spiked ~12x, tag cardinality looks ok (no explosion), but the volume is huge. ingest is fine.

Caleb Johnson: traces show shadow runner concurrency went from 200 -> 2k almost instantly. looks like the sampling rate was effectively 10x what we expected.

Amara Diallo: gateway rate limits didn’t trigger since these are internal fan-out requests after primary response. so only our shadow budgets apply.

Sean Gallagher: confirming: primary path unaffected now, but risk of capacity contention if we keep running. priority is to get GPU util down <60%.

Keiko Yamamoto: after kill switch + purge, GPU util down to ~70% and falling. queue depth decreasing.

Vanessa Ortiz: fleet contention risk dropping. dedicated pools stable.

Rafael Mendes: route policy updates applied (sampling 0). global kill switch still off. do we want to keep it off until we patch validation?

Naomi Feldman: from security/compliance: keep off is fine. please ensure no extra logging/retention changes were made during this. also confirm purge doesn’t violate audit expectations (dropping queued evals is ok).

Sean Gallagher: agree keep off until we confirm guardrails. action items:
1) Fix validation (percent vs fraction) + add server-side cap. owner: Ethan/Benji.
2) Add alert: GPU util + queue depth with paging at earlier threshold. owner: Keiko/Sean.
3) Add “effective sampling rate” dashboard & audit log on policy changes. owner: Logan/Caleb.
4) PM comms to the two beta tenants + internal update. owner: Dylan.

Dylan Brooks: will loop in Marissa + Paula now and draft customer note (shadow runs paused due to capacity safeguard; no user impact).

Ethan Park: taking (1). likely bug is RoutePolicy schema expecting 0-1 but UI treated as 0-100. i’ll push hotfix to enforce <=0.05 unless privileged override.

Benji Okafor: also adding migration check to reject old configs >5% at apply-time.

Rafael Mendes: metrics now: queue depth ~1.2k -> 300; GPU util 92% -> 58%. looks contained.

Sean Gallagher: nice. keep monitoring for 30m; then we can resolve. Rafael can you add incident summary + timestamps for postmortem.

Rafael Mendes: will do. summary: misconfigured shadow sampling on hot route caused shadow worker saturation + fleet contention risk; mitigated by global kill switch + queue purge + setting route sampling 0.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: CONDITION MET: Shadow Runner GPU utilization below threshold for 10m

Sean Gallagher: ok resolving SEV-2. follow-ups tracked in Linear (Ethan create ticket + link here). keep kill switch off until patch merged.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by Sean Gallagher
